title: Decision Table: How Long the Insurance Had Lapsed Before a Binder Is Recorded
content:
**Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing.** When support records an insurance binder on a Wayfare driver agreement, the binder acceptance days (the calendar days, from the recording day, for which the binder is accepted as the auto insurance on file) depend on how long the auto insurance on the agreement had already lapsed.

## Rule

When the auto insurance expiry date on the agreement lies more than 60 calendar days before the recording day, the binder acceptance days change by -10 days (10 days fewer); when it lies at least one but no more than 60 days before it, they change by -5 days (5 days fewer); when it is the recording day or later, they do not change.

The expiry date read is the auto insurance expiry date on the agreement as it stands on the recording day.

## Table

| Auto insurance expiry date on the agreement, counted back from the recording day | Change to the binder acceptance days |
|---|---|
| 61 days or more before | -10 |
| 1 to 60 days before | -5 |
| the recording day itself, or later | 0 |

## Edge rows (hypothetical, recording day 2026-07-01)

| Expiry date on the agreement | Days before the recording day | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-01 | 61 | -10 |
| 2026-05-02 | 60 | -5 |
| 2026-06-30 | 1 | -5 |
| 2026-07-01 | 0 | 0 |
| 2026-07-20 | (later) | 0 |
